title: Musing Murmuring Mollusk
statement: A small, moon-pale cuttlefish whose skin ripples with slow waves of color whenever it's thinking, which is nearly always, while it hums a faint bubbly murmur that only the kelp can hear. It spends its days drifting through warm lantern-lit water, arranging sea-glass pebbles into little gifts for whoever is watching (spirals, bridges, the occasional question mark), then cheerfully tidying them away to begin again.
